title: Ghostwire CVE advisory
description: One file per advisory in cve/, named <id>.json. scripts/ghostwire_cve.py validates the same rules (and more: regexes compile, mitigations name real conditions).

component.description: A version the upgrade script measures, e.g. nginx (from OpenResty), openresty, python, node, postgres, redis, app.

introduced.description: First affected version; null when every version before the fix is affected.

fixed.description: First fixed version on each branch. A version is fixed if it's at or past the fix on its own branch, or newer than every fix. Empty: no fix yet.

exposure.description: Conditions that must ALL hold for this install to be exposed. Empty: an affected version alone is exposed.

text.description: Which measured text to search, e.g. nginx_config (the live `openresty -T` dump).

pattern.description: A Python regex, searched with re.MULTILINE.

mitigations.description: Named, reversible actions the app implements (in code, never in this file). The first one the app supports is applied.

removes.description: The exposure condition ids this mitigation makes false.
